stem.text: The diagram shows a potentiometer and a fixed resistor connected across a $12\,\text{V}$ battery of negligible internal resistance.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a 12 V battery in one branch, and a fixed resistor above a potentiometer resistor (each labelled 20 Ω) in series across it, with a slider arrow to an output terminal labelled output, and a second output terminal at the bottom of the potentiometer.

stem.text: The fixed resistor and the potentiometer each have resistance $20\,\Omega$. The circuit is designed to provide a variable output voltage.
